# Vendored: @wokwi/elements

- Package: `@wokwi/elements` version **1.9.2** (published 2026-03-01)
- Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/@wokwi/elements/-/elements-1.9.2.tgz
  (file `package/dist/wokwi-elements.bundle.min.js`, unmodified)
- Repository: https://github.com/wokwi/wokwi-elements
- Licence: MIT, see `LICENSE` (copied from the package). The bundle also embeds the
  Lit library (BSD-3-Clause, Google LLC; notice kept inside the bundle).

The bundle is a classic (non-module) script that registers the `<wokwi-*>` custom elements
(e.g. `wokwi-arduino-nano`, `wokwi-led`, `wokwi-resistor`). It works offline; no build step.

To update: download a newer tarball, replace the bundle and LICENSE, and edit this file.
